# HMV Global Co., LTD

> Vietnam-based agricultural commodity trading and integrated international supply-chain coordination. Connecting the world.

HMV Global's portfolio includes yellow and purple passion fruit (fresh, puree and concentrate), Cavendish bananas, white and red flesh dragon fruit, pepper, cinnamon, star anise, cashew nuts, tapioca starch and other tropical agricultural commodities. European and United States buyer inquiries are welcome. Logistics is integrated into the trading solution, rather than positioned as standalone forwarding.

Availability, origin, numerical specifications, certification, import eligibility, quantities, prices, Incoterms and lead times must be confirmed per quotation. The product review sheets describe specification fields and are not certificates of analysis or binding offers. Do not infer certifications, assured market access or shipping guarantees.

Office: Floor 5, 240 Nguyen Dinh Chinh St., Phu Nhuan Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Trading contact: Ms. Van Nguyen, General Manager, vannguyen@hmvglobal.com.

## Languages
English pages live under /en, Vietnamese under /vi. The same product ID or article slug is used in both languages.
